listing.name: Wave Race 64: Recompiled
listing.summary: Native Wave Race 64 recompilation. Portcove installs the official packages on Windows and Linux.

steps.title: Windows: use a copy you already prepared
steps.instruction: On Windows, choose Install for the copy Portcove manages. To keep playing a copy you extracted yourself, select WaveRace64Recomp.exe with its folder as the working directory and leave arguments empty. You and upstream maintain that copy.

steps.title: Linux: prepare the host and choose Install
steps.instruction: Use an x64 host with glibc 2.43, libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.32, SDL2, GTK 3, FreeType and a working Vulkan driver. Choose Install and select your own Wave Race 64 (USA) (Rev A) original. Use Start Game after opening the managed copy.

steps.title: Keep a separate upstream Linux copy
steps.instruction: A copy you already extracted stays yours to maintain. Start it with WaveRace64Recomp.sh and use Load ROM to select your original if it has no source yet. Keep its creating runtime and profile before replacing it.

warnings: The package contains recompiled game code; some bundled components have their own notices. Use only your own original game.

references.title: Find your saves and settings
references.instruction: A copy with an empty portable.txt beside the program keeps saves and settings in its own folder: the saves folder and the .json settings files. Without it, Windows uses %LOCALAPPDATA%\WaveRace64Recomp and Linux uses $XDG_DATA_HOME/WaveRace64Recomp, usually ~/.local/share/WaveRace64Recomp. Back these up before replacing a copy you maintain.

references.title: Move from a Windows copy you added earlier
references.instruction: A v1.0.2 folder you added to Portcove keeps working where it is. Portcove doesn't copy its saves or settings into a managed copy. To switch, close the game and back up that folder's saves folder and .json settings files. Remove the registration (your files stay in place) and choose Install, but don't start the game yet. Open its saved data folder from the game's details and copy the saves folder and .json files into it. Portcove adds them to the game the first time you start it. If you've already started the managed copy, its own saves replace files copied this way.

presentation.manual_preparation: Choose your own Wave Race 64 (USA) (Rev A) original. Portcove installs the official v1.0.2 Windows or Linux x64 package, prepares a copy of the checked original beside the player and keeps the selected original in place. Portcove creates portable.txt to keep saves, settings and mods with the managed copy. Choose Start Game in the launcher.

warnings: The package contains recompiled game code; some bundled components have their own notices. Use only your own original game.

steps.title: Set up the managed copy
steps.instruction: Select your own Wave Race 64 (USA Rev A) cartridge dump. Portcove checks the original and installs its managed package. After installation, choose Play in Portcove, then Start Game in the launcher.
